basis: The dashboard title explicitly classifies the Company C Q1-Q4 record as 'Stable Revenue.' While the plotted line shows an overall increase from Q1 to Q4, the independent visual notes and checks flag that no threshold is provided to define 'growth' versus 'stability' based on the data points alone. The explicit qualitative label in the title provides the most direct mapping to the available routing options without relying on an undefined threshold.
